verdict.rationale: MoonPay documents a quotes endpoint and SDK method for fiat-to-crypto buys that return a locked rate, fees, limits, and a signature. That signature is then used to execute the transaction through headless Buy frames. Its enterprise page also claims automatic conversion of incoming fiat into stablecoins through one API. The evidence covers only the buy direction, however: the off-ramp is shown only as a widget flow, and token-to-token trading appears only as a consumer-site feature. A community user also reported having to dig for the fee chart. missing for 10: documented stablecoin-to-stablecoin conversion API, documented settlement times, API-level quotes/execution for the crypto-to-fiat direction, published fee/rate schedule in the API docs, independent hands-on corroboration.
